title: kbask.py summary: the observer summarises sprints, research, sessions, coord and the query log on request
goal: kbask.py summary QUESTION starts the same capped read-only kb-observer session with the operator's question after redact.redact on stdin, asking for a summary of the monitored work (sprints, research, sessions, coord and the query log, read from the clone's backlog and the coord store kbask is pointed at), and posts the question and the result as an ask and its answer; with --wait it prints the answer and exits 0

clauses.clause: kbask.py summary QUESTION starts the same capped read-only kb-observer session with the operator's question after redact.redact on stdin, asking for a summary of the monitored work (sprints, research, sessions, coord and the query log, read from the clone's backlog and the coord store kbask is pointed at)
posts the question and the result as an ask and its answer
with --wait it prints the answer and exits 0

gates.question: How does a summary session reach coord when kbask is pointed at a served coord (--url)?
options: Not at all: the prompt says coord is out of reach
Allow coord.py with --url and --key-file in the session's Bash rules
gates.recommendation: Not at all: the prompt says coord is out of reach
gates.answer: Not at all: the prompt says coord is out of reach

gates.question: Does a summary take the coord claim that remediate takes, and what does summary --wait exit with when the session gives no result?
options: No claim, exit 1 on no result
A claim summary/QUESTION-hash, exit 1 on no result
No claim, exit 0 with the failure printed
gates.recommendation: No claim, exit 1 on no result
gates.answer: No claim, exit 1 on no result

notes: Plan 2026-10-18 (operator, mid-plan): 'how my team's sprint and researches are going' is the same read-only agent with the operator's question. A team shares the backlog through git and coord through a serve URL (kbask --url and --key-file as coord.py takes them).
